answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 149531 Country: India Title: I am an engineer work for a government organization. I am responsible to check and confirm the items purchased by our organization. Items will be as per requirement but suppliers or vendors are offering gifts but not in the form of money. What to do? Question: I am an engineer work for a government organization. I am responsible to check and confirm the items purchased by our organization. Items will be as per requirement but suppliers or vendors are offering gifts but not in the form of money. What to do? Answer ID: 149531 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 637/606/B=6/1438) You will be getting salary from the government, in such a case, it is not lawful for you to take gift from the goods suppliers and the shopkeepers. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
